en.title: Generative art with p5.js
en.description: Create seeded generative artwork with controls for exploring visual variations.
tasks: Create seeded generative artwork with controls for exploring visual variations.
prerequisites: An agent that writes files, a browser, and access to p5.js.
en.example: Use algorithmic-art. Create a flow-field sketch with a fixed seed, adjustable density, and a reset control.
en.expectedResult: An HTML viewer and JavaScript sketch with reproducible variations.
limitations: Preview rendering and performance in your browser; external libraries require network access.

zh.title: p5.js 生成艺术
zh.description: 用固定随机种子和可调参数创作生成式图形。
tasks: 用固定随机种子和可调参数创作生成式图形。
prerequisites: 可写文件的 Agent、浏览器及 p5.js。
zh.example: 请使用 algorithmic-art：制作流场图形，提供固定种子、密度调节和重置按钮。
zh.expectedResult: HTML 查看器与 JavaScript 图形，相同种子可复现。
limitations: 需在浏览器检查画面和性能；外部库可能需要联网。
